description:
Make communication easier with dry-erase magnetic whiteboards 

Whether it’s for writing to-do lists and reminders, displaying menu options, or keeping track of important dates, dry-erase boards can help keep your messages organized and easy to see.  

Jot down ideas and turn them into easy-to-understand visuals. Custom magnetic whiteboards are great for putting concepts into outlines, so you can keep track of things that matter.   

These boards also work well as advertising space for sales and promotions. Apply on the walls of your restaurant, retail store, home office, and more to display your messages or special offers.

Customizable Graphics in a Variety of Sizes 

Traditional whiteboards are usually sold plain and without any option for branding. With custom printed magnetic whiteboards, you can add your logo or contact information to help customers remember your business.   

The front side has a dry-erase finish that is perfect for writing notes, while the magnetic back allows you to stick the whiteboard to any magnetic surface. Great for big and small spaces, these magnetic boards come in different sizes:   

Small – Ideal for tiny spaces. Use this for writing to-do lists or displaying menu options at home.  

  • 6" x 6" 
  • 12" x 18" 

 Medium – Slightly bigger and with more room for notes. Use this to jot ideas and pin photos for inspiration.   

  • 16" x 20" 
  • 18" x 24" 

 Large – Great for tasks that involve more details. Use this as a calendar to keep track of important dates and project timelines. 

  • 24" x 36" 
  • 24" x 60" 

Make the Most of Your Dry Erase Board 

With proper care, magnetic whiteboards can last for years. Make sure to use only dry-erase pens when writing. This prevents permanent staining on the board surface. Use a magnetic board eraser or microfiber rug to remove writings. If there are stubborn pen marks, a dry-erase board cleaner will clean them up easily.
